verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mollie publishes API reference pages, such as the Payments API and Payment Links API pages, plus an llms.txt index and markdown mirrors. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive explorer or runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. A static reference and markdown mirrors are adjacent features, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
